description.value: Best Western Northgate Inn is a mid-scale chain hotel situated at the hub of Vancouver Island in Nanaimo, close to Vancouver Island University and Woodgrove Mall. It offers guests a complimentary continental breakfast each morning alongside free high-speed internet. The property is individually owned and operated under the Best Western brand, making it a consistent, accessible base for cyclists exploring central Vancouver Island.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, operational Best Western hotel at 6450 Metral Drive, Nanaimo, BC V9T 2L8, matching the OSM address exactly. The page metadata tags ('free-breakfast', 'free-high-speed-internet') and overview text ('complimentary continental breakfast each morning') confirm breakfast and Wi-Fi; the OSM 'internet_access=wlan' tag corroborates Wi-Fi. No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging, etc.) appear anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those fields are null.
concerns: The hotel direct phone number (+1-250-390-2222) is listed in OSM but the scraped website content only references a toll-free central reservations line; the direct number could not be independently verified from the website text.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible hotel with a confirmed web presence and matching OSM address. Standard accommodation useful to touring cyclists passing through Nanaimo.

wow_evidence: Best Western brand, complimentary continental breakfast, free high-speed internet
